# telnyx_enterprise_reputation_external_verification (Data Source)

The review status of the ownership proof submitted for an enterprise's numbers hosted outside Telnyx.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `document_ids` (List of String) The ownership-proof documents on file.
- `phone_numbers` (List of String) The phone numbers you listed with the documents.
- `rejection_reason` (String) Why the proof was rejected. Set only when `status` is `rejected`.
- `reviewed_at` (String)
- `status` (String) Review state of the ownership proof that allows adding phone numbers hosted with another provider.
- `submitted_at` (String)
